summary: Updates the VeriSign Registry Registrar Protocol (RRP) from the Network Solutions version 1.1.0 described in RFC 2832 to version 2.0.0. It describes the changes to apply on top of that base specification. RRP is how registrars interact with the registry for domain names. It is informational.

eli5.summary: When you buy a web name, a shop tells the big name keeper about it. This document updates the rule book those shops use for talking to that keeper.

questions: what is the registry registrar protocol
